class.name: ChromaticAberrationEffect
class.brief_description: Red and blue spreading apart towards the picture's edges.
class.description: Red and blue spread apart towards the edges of the picture, as a lens bends each color a little differently. Add it to a [Compositor]'s [member Compositor.compositor_effects], on a [WorldEnvironment] or [Camera3D]. It's drawn after the scene's see-through objects, before tonemapping, in each view (both eyes in VR), with the Forward+ renderer; with the others it draws nothing.

members.member: How far apart the colors spread at the corners, as a share of the screen.
